name: Bassadewitz
summary: 4-player German trick-avoidance game where lowest card-points wins counters from a central pool.
rules_text: Played with 32 French or German-suited cards, 8 each to 4 players. Dealer posts a pool of 12 counters. Eldest hand leads first trick; winner of a trick leads next. Players must follow suit if able; highest card of led suit wins the trick; no trump. After all tricks, sum card points taken (e.g. Ace 11, Ten 10, King 4, Queen 3, Jack 2). The player with fewest points takes 5 from the pool, second fewest 4, third fewest 3. Ties favor eldest, except taking no tricks beats taking tricks worth 0 points. If one player wins all tricks, others pay him 4 each; if a player takes 100+ points without all tricks, he pays 4 to each other. In those cases and if all scores equal, pool stays and same dealer re-deals.
rating_reason: German Hearts-family game, trick-avoidance, specific playable rules.
